Democrats continue to have an edge over Republicans in vote intent for the November elections for U.S. Congress, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. 46% of registered voters say they will vote for the Democratic Party candidate in their district, and 40% will vote for the Republican candidate. That 6-point Democratic lead among registered voters is in line with recent weeks, and larger than the Democrats' low-single-digit lead for much of the summer. [...] Register

results.content:
Ja’han Jones

An Economist/YouGov poll conducted in August had similar findings. Like the Reuters/Ipsos poll, this one also found that Trump’s approval was 33% — “the smallest share to ever approve of Trump’s job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump’s terms.” It also found him at a record-high 63% disapproval.
